use_case_summary: Support chat with KB-augmented retrieval + light embeddings for reranking. Typical prompts short (10-50 tokens), but some long context messages when agents paste transcripts (~600 tokens). Throughput low-medium (30-200 reqs/min peak). Latency SLO: median <300ms, p95 <600ms for chat responses. Cost constraints mean they prefer token-efficient models + caching. They will remain on Hosted API unless tuning can't hit SLOs.
perf_issues: Observed behavior: median token latency ~260-400ms depending on hour; p95 spikes to 700-900ms in eu-west-1 during peak; cold-starts (first request of new session) add ~250ms. Their setup sends full conversation history (heavy prompts) on every request — often >2k tokens total for long threads. No prefix caching implemented. No automatic region fallback configured. Timeouts in client are 5s, sometimes timing out with larger contexts. SE noted quantization/model variant selection could help, but on Hosted API they need config tips they can change client-side.

Enable streaming (chunked) to reduce perceived latency on client UI
Implement KV/prefix caching for repeated system prompt + static KB context
Trim conversation context: send last N messages + embeddings-based retrieval instead of full history (recommend 512-1024 token window)
Increase client timeout to 10s for long-context calls while working on caching (prevent premature failures)
Configure automatic region routing for EU users to prefer eu-west-1 but fallback to us-east-1 if p95 > threshold
Try smaller model variant for low-cost quick replies and escalate to larger model only when reranking/confidence low
Set batching window to 10-20ms for bursts to amortize token costs if throughput increases
